description: This file defines the macro CreateDepPackage in CMake language, used for automating the creation of dependency packages. It sets up package parameters like name, version, description, maintainer, and dependencies, and configures the CPack tool for packaging with DEB generator.

methods.name: CreateDepPackage
methods.description: Defines a macro for creating a dependency package with specified components, name, version, description, maintainer, and dependencies, setting up CPack parameters accordingly.
